verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs standard Docker images as VMs and Linux boxes, and offers standard PostgreSQL rather than proprietary runtime or storage APIs. That implies code is not tied to Fly-specific APIs, but the evidence never states that the same code runs unmodified on other edge platforms, and it does not address any standard edge runtime API set. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of portability across multiple edge platforms, a standards-based runtime API (e.g. Web-standard APIs) commitment, independent or hands-on corroboration of unmodified cross-platform deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs

citations.quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally.
Every agent gets its own Linux box.
Fly.io's Managed Postgres is our fully-managed database service that handles all aspects of running production PostgreSQL databases
